records.synonyms_note: Chondrosum gracile Kunth and Actinochloa gracilis (Kunth) Willd. ex Roem. & Schult. are homotypic synonyms; Bouteloua stricta Vasey heterotypic.
records.concept_caution: Preserve conserved accepted combination; do not make separate Chondrosum card.
records.authority: POWO/WCVP 2026 (and listed cross-authorities where noted), checked 2026-10-18

records.synonyms_note: Bouteloua hirta Lag. and Chondrosum hirsutum (Lag.) Sweet are synonyms of B. hirsuta. POWO accepts B. pectinata Feath. separately, while ITIS has historical B. hirsuta var. pectinata mapped to B. hirsuta subsp. pectinata.
records.concept_caution: Do not fold accepted B. pectinata into B. hirsuta; preserve historical rank-treatment caution and separate existing concepts.
records.authority: POWO/WCVP 2026 (and listed cross-authorities where noted), checked 2026-10-18
records.handoff: Name-only evidence; preserve existing canonical cards, aliases, native-range data and all other lanes.
